title: Spacecraft Fire Safety Experiment-I
platform: Cygnus resupply vehicle (after deberthing from ISS)
hardware: Saffire-1 flow duct enclosure in Cygnus
fuels: SIBAL fabric (75% cotton / 25% fiberglass), ~0.94 m x 0.4 m sample
objective_summary: Determine how rapidly a large-scale fire grows in low gravity, and compare low-g flammability limits with NASA's normal-gravity material flammability screening test.
earth_applications: Fire safety in small sealed environments such as mines, airplanes and submarines.

title: SAMPLE PLACEHOLDER - Advanced Combustion via Microgravity Experiments / Cool Flames Investigation with Gases
hardware: ACME hardware in the Combustion Integrated Rack (CIR)
fuels: SAMPLE - gaseous fuel, e.g. propane (per challenge brief)
objective_summary: SAMPLE - Challenge brief: highest-O2 microgravity tests; oxygen-nitrogen mixture of up to 85% O2 flowed from a spherical burner, creating an inside-out flame. Replace with real PSI data.

title: SAMPLE PLACEHOLDER - Smoke Aerosol Measurement Experiment-Reflight
objective_summary: SAMPLE - Challenge brief: smoke detection tested in microgravity (SAME and SAME-R). Replace with real PSI data.
